latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of EaseMate AI (v1.0.0): AI-powered video editing and export via chat.
- Upload raw video footage and describe desired edits; receive ready-to-download 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with anonymous free token (100 credits, 7-day expiry); handles user authentication and session creation.
- Supports editing by prompt: trim silences, add captions, adjust format, add BGM, and more.
- File uploads up to 500MB, with support for a variety of export formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.).
- Responsive to user prompts for editing, exporting, checking credits, and session status; robust error handling included.
